Compute toroidal topography data

Source: R/directional-toroidal.R
toroidal_topography_data.Rd

Compute toroidal topography data

Usage

toroidal_topography_data(theta, phi, conditional = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

theta

First angle in radians.

phi

Second angle in radians.

conditional

If TRUE, rows are normalized to estimate f(phi | theta).

...

Additional arguments passed to estimate_toroidal_density().

Value

A data frame with columns theta, phi and density.

See also

Other toroidal dependence helpers: estimate_toroidal_density(), toroidal_flow_data(), toroidal_ridge_data()

Examples

dat <- simulate_toroidal(n = 80, seed = 1)
toroidal_topography_data(dat$theta, dat$phi, n_theta = 24, n_phi = 24)
